blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Kalag-kalag is one of the peak seasons for flower vendors, but two Cebu City vendors say the business is slowing down. Myraluna Borres, 58, and Alexander Monteclar, 68, shared with CDN Digital on October 15 that their orders were much lower than usual just days before Kalag-alag, or Halloween season, and that they fear weaker sales this 2026. The two flower vendors on Pelaez Street, Cebu City, however, aired different reasons for their worries. Borres fears El Niño could hurt her supply and her buyers’ spending, while Monteclar points to costly stock and tougher terms for suppliers. A […]...
